summary: A 38-year-old woman from Fruita became too exhausted to reach the Betty Bear backcountry hut off Trail 505 in the White River National Forest after her faster companions skied ahead; she activated the SOS feature on her Garmin inReach and texted her coordinates to Pitkin County sheriff's deputies. Mountain Rescue Aspen deployed eight members (four skiers and four on snowmobiles) and brought her to the trailhead about four hours later; she was cold but otherwise in good condition.
location: Betty Bear Hut, White River National Forest
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Roaring Fork Fire and Rescue
notes: 2022-12-29 Thursday per story. SOS ~4:50 pm; MRA deployed ~6:13 pm; at trailhead ~9:05 pm. Victim's water had frozen but she had food; a group member came from the hut to look for her; she lay in an emergency blanket until rescuers arrived.
